$comment: Behaviour settings for the server and the dashboard. Secrets, ports and paths stay in .env. The server reads this file at startup and serves it at GET /api/config; the dashboard reads it from there, so one edit changes both sides. Restart `npm run dev` after editing.

charts.$comment: Chart forms offered by the picker on each chart; default is used on load. main: combo (income/expense bars + net income line) | lines | bars (grouped) | stacked (expense groups stacked, income and net income as lines). office: lines | bars (grouped) | stacked (part-to-whole) | small (one panel per office, shared scale) | ranked (total per office over the range). showPicker=false hides the pickers and uses the defaults.

chartOfAccounts.$comment: The Chart of accounts tab: the P&L laid out on the QBO account hierarchy. hideNoActivity/hideInactive are the initial toggle states; expandDepth is how many levels open by default (0 = only account types); balanceSheetToggle offers Asset/Liability/Equity accounts with their current balance.

dashboard.$comment: Charts above the chart of accounts table. mix: revenue and expense composition by top-level account (donut | pie | bars), capped at maxSlices with the rest folded into Other. trend: top accounts over time (lines | stacked | small), topAccounts series. subType: expenses/revenue by QBO account sub-type as ranked bars, maxRows rows.
